title: The Kite That Chased the Wind

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=32 beats='Tomas and Grandma Rosa spot the spring festival poster on the bakery door; the kite contest is Saturday; the wind sock on their porch flips north, then east, then hangs flat'>>

choices.label: Start building at the workshop table

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=36 beats='On the kitchen table sit paper, string, glue, and bamboo sticks; Grandma Rosa says a changing wind is a tricky rival, so the shape they pick matters; Tomas weighs a quick diamond against a sturdy box kite'>>

choices.label: Build a red diamond kite
Build a blue box kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='They cross two bamboo sticks, tie the middle tight, and glue red tissue paper over the frame; the window rattles as the wind teases them; the new kite needs a test flight'>>

choices.label: Carry it up Windy Hill

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='On Windy Hill the red diamond leaps up, then a sudden gust snaps one bamboo stick with a crack; the kite flops in the grass; Tomas turns the broken stick over, wondering how to fix it before Saturday'>>

choices.label: Mend the stick with a garden cane
Rebuild the frame with light cedar

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='They splint the snapped stick with a thin garden cane and strong glue; on festival morning the mended kite flies but dips left whenever a gust shoves it; the sea wind comes in big pushes over the crowded field; Grandma Rosa holds out her weathered hand and offers to take the line with Tomas, or he can wrestle the dipping kite by himself'>>

choices.label: Fly it alone through the gusts
Share the line with Grandma Rosa

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Grandma Rosa planes two cedar strips thin and smooth, and Tomas rebuilds the diamond lighter and straighter than before; on festival morning the wind blows brisk and even off the sea, and the new kite tugs at the line like a puppy; the judges ring the first bell, little kids crowd the fence, and Tomas must pick how this flight will go'>>

choices.label: Enter the high-flying contest
Fly low and rock-steady
Let the little kids hold the line

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=30 beats='They roll stiff paper into tubes and build a box kite with open ends; Grandma Rosa says box kites love strong wind; outside, the ridge pines sway one way and then the other'>>

choices.label: Test it in the low meadow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=38 beats='In the low meadow the air goes completely still and the box kite sits down in the clover; Grandma Rosa points at the ridge, where the treetops still flutter, and says the wind is up there hiding its tricks'>>

choices.label: Learn to read the moving air
Tighten every knot and cut vents

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Grandma Rosa shows Tomas how the ridge trees and the bakery flag tell where the wind will jump next, and he calls three gusts right before the leaves even move; on festival morning kites crowd the sky like confetti and the flags keep swinging to new directions; the first bell rings across the field, and Tomas watches for his moment'>>

choices.label: Call the wind window and launch
Wait for the calm sunset round
Squeeze into the crowd right now

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='Tomas reties every bridle string with the fisherman knot Grandma Rosa learned on the harbor docks, and they cut small vent flaps so big gusts blow through instead of tearing the paper; festival morning brings a hard pushing wind that snaps the square flags straight out; at the field Grandma Rosa asks what kind of line this wind needs'>>

choices.label: Fly on a short, reefed line
Let out the whole spool

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Tomas plants his feet and fights the line alone; the mended kite dips harder with every shove of wind; his arms shake as one giant gust rolls in, and Grandma Rosa calls that her hands are ready if he wants them'>>

choices.label: Hold on tight by himself
Wave Grandma Rosa over to help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='Four hands take one line; Grandma Rosa leans when Tomas leans, and the dipping kite steadies between them as the gusts keep pushing across the festival field'>>

choices.label: Steer it together

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Tomas lets the line run out turn after turn, and the light cedar kite climbs past every other kite; near the last turns of the spool the string starts to strain and hum in his hands'>>

choices.label: Let it climb to the very top
Ease off and hold it steady

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='Tomas keeps the line short and the kite low, holding it flat and calm while wobbling kites dive and crash all around the festival field'>>

choices.label: Hold it steady

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='One by one the little kids take the humming line in both hands while Tomas stands behind each of them, calling out when to pull and when to let the wind work'>>

choices.label: Cheer them on

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='Tomas watches the ridge trees, calls the wind window out loud, and launches the box kite the very moment the moving air sweeps down across the field'>>

choices.label: Ride the wind window

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='They let the wild morning rounds go by, eat warm churros while the band plays, and carry the box kite out when the evening air turns smooth and golden'>>

choices.label: Launch at sunset

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='Tomas squeezes into a small gap between kites and launches; the wind swings and his line drifts toward the striped kite of a girl named Mia; the ridge trees promise clear air at the open edge of the field'>>

choices.label: Keep flying in the crowd
Walk the kite to the open edge

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=30 beats='On the short reefed line the box kite sits steady as a table in the hard wind, humming while little kids gather underneath with their mouths open'>>

choices.label: Keep it low and steady

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=30 beats='The box kite hauls line off the old spool up and up until the string sings like a guitar; the spool jumps and jerks in Tomas hands as the last turns come loose'>>

choices.label: Let it climb to the last turn
Reel it back down low

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='A hard gust rips the sail corner to corner and the kite sinks to the grass; Tomas blinks back tears; Grandma Rosa folds the torn kite gently and promises they will build a stronger one together next spring'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='Together they steer through every gust, leaning and laughing while the kite swoops and settles; no ribbon comes their way and they do not care; the kite they built and fixed together dances over the festival all afternoon'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='The judge pins a blue ribbon to Tomas jacket for the highest flight of the whole festival; Grandma Rosa cheers loudest of all; Tomas grins, remembering the snapped stick that turned into their best kite ever'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='Their kite is not the highest but it is the steadiest, and the judge with the blue sash says steady beats lucky every time; Tomas and Grandma Rosa carry the steady-flier prize home between them'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='Every little kid lands a smooth turn on the line, and Tomas realizes he can teach what took him all week to learn; Grandma Rosa laughs and says the festival just found its youngest kite teacher'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='The box kite rises straight into the moving river of air, right when Tomas said it would; he can read the changing wind now, the very thing that ruined every test, and Grandma Rosa beams with pride'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='They miss the big morning contest and Tomas feels a small pang; but at sunset the tricky wind finally settles smooth and warm, and their kite floats alone in the orange sky over the quiet square'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='The two lines cross and both kites spiral gently down to the grass; Tomas and Mia untangle string for ages, trade kite-fixing tricks, and plan to fly together tomorrow while Grandma Rosa shares her churros'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='The box kite holds its place all morning while wilder kites crash around it, and the crowd claps for the steady blue box; Grandma Rosa squeezes Tomas shoulder and calls it a kite worth every knot'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=38 beats='One mean gust snaps the last stretch of line and the box kite sails away over the rooftops toward the sea; Tomas watches it shrink to a dot; Grandma Rosa keeps the empty spool as a lesson for next spring'>>
